public_case.title: Common specialist case: chronic total occlusion with stable symptoms

symptoms: Persistent exertional angina despite a reported trial of anti-anginal therapy.
Symptoms for several months, stable in the last two weeks; no acute rest pain in the entry scenario.
medications: Medication list incomplete; assess adherence, contraindications and symptom response

pathways.label: Specialist review of symptoms, ischemia/viability and CTO complexity
supports: Chronic total occlusion (CTO) in a patient with stable symptoms; symptom burden, ischemia/viability, anatomy, procedural complexity and patient goals determine whether specialist CTO evaluation is appropriate.
pathways.reason: The decision is individualized; symptom benefit and procedural risk must be considered.
